Subtracting 299 days from 1834-10-15:  
1834 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Days in each month before Oct 15:  
From Oct 15 back 14 days → Oct 1.  
From Oct 1 back 30 days (Sept) → Sep 1.  
From Sep 1 back 31 days (Aug) → Aug 1.  
From Aug 1 back 31 days (Jul) → Jul 1.  
From Jul 1 back 30 days (Jun) → Jun 1.  
From Jun 1 back 31 days (May) → May 1.  
From May 1 back 30 days (Apr) → Apr 1.  
From Apr 1 back 31 days (Mar) → Mar 1.  
From Mar 1 back 28 days (Feb non-leap) → Feb 1.  
From Feb 1 back 31 days (Jan) → Jan 1, 1834.  

Days used so far: 14 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 28 + 31 = 287 days.  
Need 299 total, so 299 − 287 = 12 more days back from Jan 1, 1834 → Dec 20, 1833.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1833-12-20
